classification.difficultyReason: One theorem: the ticked equal distances give equal chords, so x is read straight from the other chord. No computation.

answer.worked:
The perpendiculars from $O$ to the two chords are equal, so the chords are equidistant from the centre. Chords equidistant from the centre are equal in length.
$$\begin{align*}x&=AB\\x&=17\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
